title: Kissed Tender Croatian Peas Stew
description: A traditional Croatian dish featuring tender petit pois, this stew is fermented to bring out the natural sweetness of the peas and is perfect for a weeknight dinner. It is a low-fat-friendly option that can be made with minimal ingredients.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chopped carrot and celery and cook until they are tender.
Add the petit pois, vegetable broth, and tomato paste, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Stir in the sodium alginate and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Use a spoon to drop small amounts of the stew into a bath of cold water to spherify the peas.
Serve the spherified peas in the stew.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
